display_long_description:
**Face your fears in realistic VR spelunking. Explore fictional and real-life caves recreated in VR, including the infamous Nutty Putty cave guided by a real-life rescuer. Tackle steep climbs and narrow tunnels with physical tools and authentic techniques. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op.**

# Story Mode
[media]
Follow the story of Jake, who is retracing the footsteps of his father, a famous spelunker, and uncover family secrets as he descends deeper into the abyss of the caves.

# Tourist Mode
[media]
A journey through the infamous Nutty Putty cave, guided by an exclusive audio commentary from Brandon Kowallis, a real-life rescuer from the tragic 2009 incident and original cartographer who mapped its treacherous passages before they were closed forever.
# Horror Mode
[media]
Chilling experience designed to trigger your deepest phobias. Explore unpredictable cave systems where the darkness itself feels alive, facing a shifting variety of psychological and environmental horrors.

# Arcade Mode
[media]
Race against time as you climb, swing, and scramble your way through challenging routes. Mark your name on the leaderboard and compete with other players!

# Paint Cave
[media]
Multiplayer mode where you and other players showcase your creativity under time pressure. Draw the phrase, vote for the best one, and prepare for lots of sudden laugh bursts.
